description.value: The Mountain Pantry is a grocery and liquor store situated in the pedestrian village at Fernie Alpine Resort, stocking a broad range of supplies including fresh produce, dairy, frozen meals, wines, spirits, and over-the-counter pharmacy items — making it a practical resupply point for cyclists in the Elk Valley. The store also features a Coffee Bar serving Starbucks and carries locally hand-crafted products and Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory goods.

address.value: 5339 Ski Hill Road, Fernie, BC V0B 1M6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content from skifernie.com/the-mountain-pantry/ confirms this is a real, operating grocery and liquor store in the village at Fernie Alpine Resort, with an explicit product list including fresh produce, dairy, frozen meals, wines, spirits, grab-and-go food, and a Starbucks coffee bar. The resort's general phone number and address appear in the footer and are used here since OSM carries no contact details. No bike parking, bike racks, or water refill infrastructure is mentioned anywhere on the website or in the OSM tags, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM name is 'Mountain Pantry Grocery & Liquor' but website consistently refers to it as 'Mountain Pantry Grocery & Liquor Store' (with 'Store' appended) — minor discrepancy.
Phone number and address sourced from resort-wide footer on skifernie.com, not store-specific contact details; OSM carries no address or phone for this record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible grocery and liquor store at Fernie Alpine Resort with a confirmed product range; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in the Kootenays.

Hot food.detail: Website states the store has a Coffee Bar and 'proudly serves Starbucks' hot specialty coffee
